propositions: reconcile_check.py performs vendor-shape comparisons using ad-hoc vendor-specific sibling loads (outbound_fields.py, adf.py) instead of reusing the canonical InboundMapper machinery, creating a second unrecorded backend reach-through and correctness hole for non-Jira backends

The assignee, description, and status/priority field comparisons must be canonicalized by applying the configured backend's InboundMapper.map_remote_to_local to the snapshot entry once per bound pair, then comparing in local vocabulary instead of raw vendor format

The by-path sibling loads (_load_outbound_fields, _load_adf) and the adapters/jira vendor reach-throughs must be deleted, with the backend_neutrality gate extended to detect both import-based and path-literal string-based vendor dependencies in reconcile_check.py

Description comparison must mirror the canonical differ's parity rule using OutboundMapper.map_fields_to_remote for ADF fitting plus rstrip-tolerant text matching, not FieldSanitizer.sanitize_description which emits warnings inappropriate for diagnostics

Annotation-label status precedence (rebar-status:blocked/cancelled) now correctly flows through canonical mapping in reconcile_check, matching the real differ behavior and representing an intended correctness improvement
Discrepancy reports retain the raw snapshot jira_value unchanged while internal comparisons use canonical mapped values, preserving report shape and consumer contracts
